name: wsClose
description: Close a socket (the closing handshake; network.onWsClose follows). A socket still connecting is abandoned and its wsOpen fails CANCELLED. Returns { found }. Additive action: an older host answers NOT_IMPLEMENTED.

inputs.name: code
inputs.description: Close code, default 1000. As the WebSocket API's close(): 1000 or 3000-4999, INVALID_ARGS otherwise.

inputs.name: reason
inputs.description: Close reason, at most 123 UTF-8 bytes (INVALID_ARGS otherwise).
